name: cobalt-cockpit
description: A live mission-control layer for Claude Code with cyberpunk HUD, orchestration telemetry, dynamic task-aware reasoning effort, verification-gated progress, Run Ledger, replay, session parking, command safety, and optional local-control integration.

hud.title: Show the HUD
hud.description: Draw the compact particle progress band above the prompt.

animation.title: Animate progress particles
animation.description: Twinkle particles and glide the stage pill only while work is active.

sounds.title: Play sounds
sounds.description: Play the checkpoint cue at 80% and the completion cue at a verified 100%.

volume.title: Sound volume
volume.description: Cue volume from 0 to 1, for players that take one.

blastRadiusGuard.title: Blast-radius guard
blastRadiusGuard.description: Ask before genuinely destructive commands (hard reset, clean, force push, broad recursive deletes, database drops, production teardown).

attributionGuard.title: AI attribution guard
attributionGuard.description: Keep AI attribution out of commits, pull requests and files, and ask before CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md is created unasked.

telemetry.title: Local model telemetry
telemetry.description: Keep a bounded local record of observed model requests, subagents, router calls and Opus consultations under ~/.local/state/cobalt-cockpit/telemetry/ for /cockpit stats. No prompt, code, path or secret is stored and nothing is uploaded.

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: Freeze particles and move the progress head directly; desktop also respects prefers-reduced-motion.

localControl.title: Local Control telemetry
localControl.description: Read the decision-router ledger read-only and flash a line when a real prune or decision receipt arrives, with a LOCAL CONTROL section in /cockpit. Nothing is shown when no receipt is observed.

ledgerPath.title: Telemetry ledger path
ledgerPath.description: Override the decision-router ledger path. Defaults to $XDG_STATE_HOME/decision-router/ledger.jsonl, then $HOME/.local/state.

orchestration.title: Orchestration rules
orchestration.description: Observe by default. Enable the Opus 5.5 commander at the effort you set, elastic Sonnet 5.5 engineering and Haiku 5.5 utility pools with task-aware effort, task ownership and resource admission.

profile.title: Orchestration profile
profile.description: With orchestration enforced: OPUS_LED (default, legacy) keeps the Opus 5.5 main loop as commander. SONNET_LED runs the main loop on Sonnet 5.5 at your chosen effort, Haiku 5.5 scouts, and Opus 5.5 only as an admitted architect/reviewer consultation (one at a time; mandatory for explicit requests, release approval and security-sensitive files). SONNET_LED's AUTO budgets are 4 helpers: 2 Sonnet, 2 Haiku, 1 Opus.

routerConfigDir.title: Router configuration for JEV mode
routerConfigDir.description: Optional. A decision-router configuration directory you created for Cockpit's JEV mode (for example ~/.config/cobalt-cockpit/router-jev, a copy of your router config with JEV enabled). It is passed as DECISION_ROUTER_CONFIG_DIR to the router's child process only while this session's router is JEV (/cockpit router jev). Empty: the router's own configuration and its JEV switch apply. Cockpit never creates or edits router configuration, and the router is OFF in every new session.

maxSubagents.title: Parallel subagents
maxSubagents.description: Concurrent subagent resource budget: 0 selects AUTO (16 total); explicit values 1–128. Tasks remain queued until dependencies and ownership are safe.

subscriptionOnly.title: Subscription only
subscriptionOnly.description: Opt-in refusal of API-style authentication. Cockpit never changes your launcher or credentials.

blockFable.title: Block Fable
blockFable.description: Opt-in block of Fable model routes. Off in public defaults.

cobaltStrict.title: Strict Cobalt preset
cobaltStrict.description: Explicitly enforce orchestration, block Fable and external advisor selection, and require subscription-style authentication. Overrides individual switches while enabled.

reasoningMode.title: Reasoning mode
reasoningMode.description: AUTO names a reasoning level from each task: extractive work light, engineering medium, complex debugging, concurrency, migration, security and high-risk architecture high or xhigh. MANUAL honours the fixed per-tier levels. An explicit level on a task always wins. The main loop's effort is always yours (/effort, --effort, CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL): Cockpit reads it and never rewrites it.

maxEffort.title: Reasoning effort ceiling
maxEffort.description: Nothing above this level is ever requested for a subagent; a higher ask falls back and is recorded. Each model also has its own supported ceiling, so the applied level may still be lower. The main loop's own level is not Cockpit's to cap: use maxEffortLevel in settings for that.

maxSonnetAgents.title: Sonnet pool resource budget
maxSonnetAgents.description: Independent Sonnet concurrency budget: -1 selects AUTO (8); 0 disables this pool; 1–128 selects an explicit budget, subject to the total budget.

maxHaikuAgents.title: Haiku pool resource budget
maxHaikuAgents.description: Independent Haiku concurrency budget: -1 selects AUTO (16); 0 disables this pool; 1–128 selects an explicit budget, subject to the total budget.
